decisions.reason: The indoor air quality module has its own page and fits the firm's sensing focus, and post-pandemic demand for air monitoring likely keeps its results at or above aspiration, so no problemistic search is triggered.
As the current-generation replacement for an established voltage measurement module, it is a core building block with low carrying cost, and dropping it would leave a gap in the modular platform.

The CAN bus interface serves industrial and automotive automation customers, carries little marginal cost on the shared platform, and adds to the platform's breadth, which justifies keeping it despite modest visibility.

The CO2 sensor module has its own page, complements the air quality product, and likely meets aspirations given strong interest in ventilation monitoring, so the firm has no reason to redeploy its resources.
